Name: Server Browser
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
[size=3]Adds an online public server browser. Note that you must the Steam version of the game for its multiplayer servers.[/size]

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/hpf434dpsf1l7r6/20190106174228_1.jpg[/img]

[size=4][b]Usage[/b][size=3]
To join a server, click the online button after opening the Co-Op menu on the title screen. You can view all the servers on the next screen. Check any filters and refresh if you want.

[size=4][size=3]To host a server, check the 'Public' checkbox on the host menu. Configure your server information in the config.json file. In ServerMessage, create new lines by adding a [font=Courier New][size=2]\n[/size][/font] [/size][/size]
In RequiredMods, the mods should be the UniqueID of each mod (check each mod's manifest). Place between double quotes and separate with commas. e.g: [font=Courier New][size=2]"RequiredMods": [ "Ilyaki.BattleRoyalley", "Ilyaki.ArtifactSystemFixed" ],[/size][/font]
If you would like to ban any mods (remember that SMAPI comes default with a cheat mod), use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2887][font=Courier New]Anti-Cheat Server mod[/font][/url]

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][size=3][list=1][*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip [font=Courier New]ServerBrowser.zip[/font] into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[/size][/b][list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3199]Battle Royalley[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2677]Always on Server[/url]﻿. (Lets you run a 24/7 dedicated server) If you use this mod, set PublicCheckedByDefault to true in config.json

[/list][/size][b]

Downloads.Description:
Fixed the online tab not opening seemingly randomly. (Steam servers that pointed to a non-existent GoG galaxy server would cause it to crash)

Tested on Stardew Valley 1.3.33 with SMAPI 2.10.1
